name: human_at_budget
_comment: Reproduces the 2026-08-26 dead end. The Developer never converges, so the Arbiter is called twice INSIDE the loop and both times decides on its own (REVIEWER_IS_RIGHT) - neither of those rulings may swallow a pending --human-answer. The dispute survives to the iteration budget (max_iterations=10). Without --human-answer the tail arbiter returns NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION and the run PAUSES (AWAITING_HUMAN). With --human-answer the answer outranks the arbiter at that stop point, is applied as the binding ruling, and buys human_resume_iterations extra iterations - the Developer then returns FEASIBLE and the Tech Lead READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW -> PASS. Before the fix this scenario paused in BOTH cases: the answer was cleared by the mid-loop arbiter and the boundary had no iteration left to apply it.
